summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the initiation of a EUR 200 million share buyback program beginning July 1, 2026, with expected completion by December 23, 2026. This follows the completion of a prior EUR 227 million buyback that repurchased 33,909,553 shares at an average price of EUR 6.68 per share. Largest shareholder Vereniging Aegon (18.4% voting rights) agreed to participate pro-rata for EUR 37 million. Shares repurchased will be canceled or used for compensation plans. The program complies with EU regulations and existing shareholder authority. Watch for repurchase pace and cancellation impact; no premium or tender offer involved.
